title: Stormwater administrator
text:
19.31.070 Stormwater administrator.
Responsible Official and Initial Decision-Maker. The stormwater administrator shall be the person designated by the city manager to be the responsible official and initial decision-maker for all stormwater management under Chapter 15.20 of this code.
(Ord. 16921 § 1 (part), 2008: Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
